name: Estrogen, androgen and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: All members concern nuclear/membrane sex steroid receptor signaling and responses; unlike the estrous-cycle, gland-development, thyroid-receptor and RUNX2 neighbours it combines estrogen receptor transcription with androgen receptor (KLK, prostate) signaling.

name: Nuclear receptor and SREBP control of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members are LXR, PPARA, ROR/REV-ERB, PGC-1alpha and SREBP transcriptional regulation of cholesterol, lipid and glucose metabolism; unlike neighbours it carries SREBP/cholesterol homeostasis and generic nuclear receptor transcription rather than adipocyte differentiation or ChREBP sugar sensing.

name: Telomere maintenance by recombination and break-induced replication
rationale: Members cover telomere capping, D-loop, t-circle and recombination-based telomere maintenance plus DNA unwinding; unlike the other telomere neighbours it includes break-induced replication, resolution of recombination intermediates and intra-S checkpoint.

core: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization in apoptosis
name: BH3-only and BCL-2 family control of mitochondrial permeabilization
rationale: All members concern BH3-only protein activation, BAX/BAK oligomerization and regulation of MOMP and cytochrome c release; unlike neighbours it lacks downstream apoptosome, caspase and SMAC steps.

name: RHOBTB, RHO and Ral GTPase activity regulation
rationale: All members concern activation, inactivation or effector cycles of small GTPases (RHOBTB1-3, Rhotekin/Rhophilin, Ral); unlike the RAB/ARF neighbour it centres on RHOBTB and Ral, and unlike others it lacks proteolysis, neddylation and Golgi terms.

name: Positive and negative regulation of complement activation
rationale: All members regulate the complement cascade (classical and alternative pathways, both directions); neighbours instead hold the activation steps themselves (C3/C5 activation, lectin, antibody-mediated).

name: Cerebellar granule layer and brainstem development
rationale: Members concern hindbrain maturation: cerebellar granule precursors, Bergmann glia, granular layer, pons/brainstem and their motor/respiratory functions; unlike neighbours it lacks Purkinje layer, forebrain and locomotor-behaviour terms.

qualifier: cardiac outflow tract and great arteries
name: Pharyngeal arch derivative and cardiac outflow tract development
rationale: Members are pharyngeal-arch-derived organs (thymus, parathyroid, thyroid, palate, trachea) plus neural-crest-dependent outflow tract and pharyngeal arch artery morphogenesis; unlike craniofacial and limb neighbours it includes the outflow tract, pulmonary artery and trachea.

qualifier: nicotinate NAD salvage and pantothenate-derived coenzyme A
name: Vitamin-derived NAD salvage and coenzyme A biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover nicotinate/pyridine nucleotide salvage, NAD(P) metabolism and transport, and pantothenate-to-CoA synthesis; unlike neighbours it lacks tryptophan de novo NAD, PDH acetyl-CoA, peroxisomal and creatine terms.

name: Inherited MyD88, IRAK4 and IKK-NF-kB immunodeficiencies
rationale: All members are germline defects of the TLR-MyD88-IRAK4-IKK-IkBA signaling axis (EDA-ID, SCID); neighbours hold the normal TLR, NOD, inflammasome and non-canonical NF-kB signaling rather than disease variants.

core: T and NK cell transcriptional signature
name: Combined T and NK cell blood transcriptional signature
rationale: All three members are blood transcriptional signatures enriched in T and NK lymphocytes and their activation; neighbours are separately T-cell differentiation/costimulation or NK cytotoxicity programs.

qualifier: chamber myocardium and second heart field
name: Chamber myocardium and second heart field development
rationale: Members concern heart tube, second heart field and ventricular/atrial myocardium (compact, trabecular) growth and differentiation; unlike neighbours it lacks valve/endocardial cushion, conduction system and left-right patterning terms.

name: Lipid droplet dynamics and triglyceride storage
rationale: Members concern formation, fusion, disassembly and lipophagy of lipid droplets and the regulation of stored triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis in fat cells; neighbours instead hold fatty acid oxidation, TAG/PA synthesis enzymes or LXR transcription.

core: Endosomal trafficking and membrane protein targeting
name: Early endosome trafficking and GLUT4 plasma membrane translocation
rationale: Members concern early endosome transport, pinocytosis, transcytosis and targeting of proteins to membranes, including GLUT4 translocation and RHOQ/RHOT GTPase cycles; unlike neighbours it lacks clathrin/caveolin endocytosis, receptor internalization and macropinocytosis terms.

qualifier: thyroid hormone receptor and liver development
name: Thyroid hormone receptor transcription and liver development
rationale: Members combine thyroid hormone receptor signaling and nuclear receptor transcription with hepatocyte proliferation, differentiation and liver regeneration; neighbours are sex steroid, metabolic or retinoic acid receptor programs without the liver terms.

name: Viral envelope protein maturation and budding-site assembly
rationale: All members concern post-translational maturation of coronavirus spike, E, 3a and dengue structural proteins and their assembly at the budding site; neighbours hold viral entry, attachment and replicase translation.

qualifier: post-translational processing, trafficking and degradation of CDH1/CDH11
name: Post-translational regulation of E-cadherin and cadherin-11
rationale: All three members concern cadherin proteins themselves (CDH1 processing, trafficking and degradation; CDH11 interactions); neighbours cover cadherin gene transcription, adherens junction assembly and desmosomes.

name: Extracellular matrix, laminin and complement co-expression signature
rationale: All members are co-expression modules enriched for extracellular matrix and associated proteins (laminins, metallopeptidases, complement); unlike neighbours it lacks collagen/elastic fibre assembly, integrin signaling and fibroblast-proliferation terms.

name: Lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism and glycolipid transport
rationale: Members cover lysosomal ganglioside/glycosphingolipid breakdown, its storage diseases (GM2, sialidosis) and glycolipid/ceramide-1-phosphate transport; neighbours hold sialic acid and N-glycan metabolism or glycosphingolipid biosynthesis.

name: Ribosomal RNA transcription elongation and termination
rationale: Members concern RNA polymerase I elongation and termination, 5S rRNA transcription by Pol III and ITS2 cleavage; neighbours hold Pol I initiation/promoter and chromatin control or early 5'-ETS/ITS1 processing.

qualifier: TRKA and TRKB via PI3K, ERK5 and CREB
name: TRKA and TRKB signaling via PI3K, ERK5 and CREB
rationale: Members are NGF/TRKA (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, p38, CREB, transcription) and BDNF/NTF3-TRKB (PI3K, CDK5, RAC1) downstream signaling; unlike neighbours it lacks NTRK3, the TRKB RAS/PLCG1 branches and p75NTR death signaling.

name: Reproductive behavior, parturition and uterine contraction
rationale: Members cover mating, parental and aggressive behavior, insemination, erection and relaxin-linked uterine contraction at parturition; unlike neighbours it combines reproductive behaviors with parturition rather than tachykinin, drinking, exploratory or urinary smooth muscle terms.

qualifier: spliceosome assembly and splice site recognition
name: Spliceosome assembly and pre-mRNA splice site recognition
rationale: All members concern spliceosome assembly, tri-snRNP formation, splice site recognition and catalytic activation (major and minor); neighbours hold snRNA transcription/snRNP biogenesis, nuclear RNA decay and Pol III transcription.

name: Hydrogen peroxide-induced cell death and ferroptosis regulation
rationale: Members concern responses to peroxide and nitrosative stress and the regulation of H2O2-induced intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis; unlike neighbours it carries ferroptosis/iron vulnerability and lacks ischemia, hydrogen sulfide and respiration control terms.

qualifier: bilirubin and drugs via SLCO, UGT1A1 and ABCC2
name: Bilirubin and drug organic anion hepatic clearance
rationale: Members cover heme degradation, SLCO/UGT1A/ABCC2-dependent bilirubin handling and their hyperbilirubinemias, and SLCO-mediated ADME of drugs; unlike xenobiotic metabolism and SLC22 transporter neighbours it centres on bilirubin.
